findings.message: Rule-bearing legacy code in Freight.Rules.needsSignature matches no observation and has rule-bearing constructs without accepted authority (ast analyzer). No accepted authority: case keyed on DangerousGoods (line 17): no accepted record names DangerousGoods; case keyed on ColdChain (line 18): no accepted record names ColdChain; case keyed on General (line 19): no accepted record names General. A category test treats one category differently (a possible exemption); a record that names the category must authorize it. Question for praxis-intake: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.

Rule-bearing legacy code in Freight.Rules.maxDeliveryAttempts matches no observation and has rule-bearing constructs without accepted authority (ast analyzer). Superseded authority: numeric literal 3 (line 21): value 3 = DEC-FR06.p1 (superseded by DEC-FR08, same form) and no accepted parameter has the same form. The code still carries a superseded decision's value. Question for Last Mile Operations: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.
